blocks.orig: Exploring all that Tanzania has to offer is a dream for many. From epic Tanzania safari adventures spotting Africa’s Big Five, to climbing Kilimanjaro or relaxing on the paradise beaches of Zanzibar: Tanzania has it all. Good news: Your Tanzania Trip can build a custom made itinerary that suits all your wishes.
blocks.html: For many people, discovering everything Tanzania has to offer is a dream. Whether it is an epic Tanzania safari in search of Africa’s Big Five, a Kilimanjaro climb or time on the paradise beaches of Zanzibar: you will find it all in Tanzania. The good news is that Your Tanzania Trip can put together a custom made itinerary around all your wishes.

blocks.orig: Our most popular itineraries can help you find some inspiration. Most of our clients love to end their exciting safari with a few days of relaxation on one of Zanzibar’s most stunning beaches. Would you like that as well?
blocks.html: Looking for inspiration? Our most popular itineraries are a good place to start. Most of our clients like to round off their exciting safari with a few relaxing days on one of Zanzibar’s most stunning beaches. Does that appeal to you too?

blocks.orig: Whether you choose one of our popular Tanzania itineraries or prefer to customize your journey, we are here to assist you. Come aboard and get ready to explore Tanzania at your own pace, exactly the way you like it!
blocks.html: Whether you pick one of our popular Tanzania itineraries or would rather shape the journey yourself, we are happy to help. Join us and get ready to discover Tanzania at your own pace, just the way you want!

blocks.orig: As you walk out of Kilimanjaro International Airport, your personal Your Tanzania Trip guide greets you with a big smile: 'Karibu Tanzania - welcome to Tanzania!' The guide takes you straight to your hotel, where you can relax and take in the African atmosphere. The next day your guide takes you on an exclusive, private safari that allows you to travel at your own pace. Enjoy the luxury of your own safari jeep and take the liberty to stop and watch the animals as long as you like!
blocks.html: When you step out of Kilimanjaro International Airport, your own Your Tanzania Trip guide is there to meet you with a broad smile: 'Karibu Tanzania - welcome to Tanzania!' Your guide drives you directly to the hotel, so you can unwind and soak up the African atmosphere. The following day you set off on an exclusive private safari where you set the pace yourself. You have your own safari jeep, and you are free to stop and watch the animals for as long as you wish!

blocks.orig: After a magical flight over Tanzania's savannahs, you arrive in the heart of Tarangire National Park. Your driver awaits you here for your first game drive of the day. Usually, your flight takes you to the park in time for lunch, which you can have in the middle of the savannah. A classic safari sundowner concludes the day, and the sight of the last sun shining over the herds of elephants and the ancient baobabs trees of the Tarangire plains is truly mesmerizing!
blocks.html: Following a magical flight across Tanzania's savannahs, you land in the heart of Tarangire National Park. Here your driver is ready for the first game drive of the day. Your flight usually gets you to the park in time for lunch, which you can enjoy out on the savannah. The day ends with a classic safari sundowner, and watching the last sunlight fall on the elephant herds and the ancient baobab trees of the Tarangire plains is truly mesmerising!

blocks.orig: In the majestic Tarangire National Park, the focus lies on grandeur - cross paths with the countless gigantic baobab trees, in search of vast herds of elephants. And these giants are not the only large game you find here, since the Tarangire River and Lake Burunge attract countless lions, zebras, giraffes, leopards, cheetahs, pythons, and monkeys to their waters. For smaller species, the grandeur lies in the numbers, as Tarangire is also an absolute haven for birdwatchers!
blocks.html: Grandeur is the theme in majestic Tarangire National Park - you pass countless giant baobab trees while you look for large herds of elephants. These giants are not the only big game here, because the Tarangire River and Lake Burunge draw countless lions, zebras, giraffes, leopards, cheetahs, pythons and monkeys to the water. For the smaller species, the grandeur is in their numbers, as Tarangire is also a true haven for birdwatchers!

blocks.orig: Gibb's Farm offers the old-age rhythm of an African farm and coffee plantation, right on the slopes of Ngorongoro Highlands. Walk around on this sanctuary of peace and tranquility, and watch vegetables being harvested, coffee roasted, cows milked, and pigs fed. The vegetable gardens, fruit trees, and herbs provide inspiration for the farm's chefs, who in their turn amaze visitors with a delicious lunch. A little piece of heaven!
blocks.html: On the slopes of the Ngorongoro Highlands, Gibb's Farm keeps to the age-old rhythm of an African farm and coffee plantation. Stroll around this peaceful, tranquil sanctuary and see vegetables being picked, coffee being roasted, cows being milked and pigs being fed. The farm's chefs draw inspiration from the vegetable gardens, fruit trees and herbs, and they then treat visitors to a delicious lunch. A small slice of heaven!

blocks.orig: Today you descend into the wonderous caldera of the famous Ngorongoro Crater. This is THE day to start your game drive early when animals are plenty and tourists few! Feel the little hairs on your arms rise as you descend into the crater, awed by the sight of clouds hovering and the numerous animals in sight. Coyotes, hyenas, buffaloes, wildebeests, gazelles, and many more animals can be found here and you are almost guaranteed to see them all.
blocks.html: Today you go down into the wondrous caldera of the famous Ngorongoro Crater. This is THE day for an early start to your game drive, when there are plenty of animals and few tourists! The hairs on your arms will stand up as you descend, amazed by the clouds hanging over the crater and the many animals in view. You can find coyotes, hyenas, buffaloes, wildebeests, gazelles and many more animals here, and you are almost guaranteed to see them all.

blocks.orig: Fly into the mind-blowing beautiful Serengeti National Park for the epitome of safari. See the infamous Big Five in all their glory, and, in certain months, wildebeests running by the thousands in the Great Migration. And even without that; this is big-cat-paradise with prides of lions on kopjes, cheetahs in the long, yellow grass, and leopards in trees. You arrive in time for an amazing afternoon game drive into the sunset.
blocks.html: Fly in to Serengeti National Park, stunningly beautiful and the very essence of safari. Here you can admire the infamous Big Five at their best, and during certain months watch thousands of wildebeests stream past on the Great Migration. Even outside those months this is a paradise for big cats; lions rest in prides on the kopjes, cheetahs hide in the tall yellow grass and leopards lounge up in the trees. Your arrival leaves time for a wonderful game drive in the afternoon, heading into the sunset.

blocks.orig: Anything you can think of when you picture a luxurious safari, you will surely find in Serengeti National Park. Not only the Big Five, the famous Great Migration, and a multitude of big cats, but also rarer species such as the gerenuk or the wild dog, and did we mention the plus 500 species of birds? In between, you naturally spot antelopes, giraffes, elephants, zebras, hippos, and many more animals. Make sure to wake up at sunrise for an epic balloon safari...!
blocks.html: Whatever you imagine when you think of a luxurious safari, Serengeti National Park is sure to have it. Not just the Big Five, the famous Great Migration and many big cats, but also rarer species like the gerenuk or the wild dog, and did we mention more than 500 species of birds? Along the way you will naturally see antelopes, giraffes, elephants, zebras, hippos and many other animals. Be sure to get up at sunrise for an epic balloon safari...!

blocks.orig: After an amazing safari adventure, you take a plane back to Arusha, after which you are transferred to Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO) for your international flight home.
blocks.html: Once your safari adventure is over, a plane brings you back to Arusha. From there, a transfer takes you on to Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO), where you catch your international flight home.
